pr_metadata.title: bindings(python): Remove hard `absl-py` dependency
pr_metadata.description:
This commit refactors the public `google_benchmark` APIs to work without `absl-py` installed in the current virtual environment. It also removes `absl-py` from the list of PyPI package dependencies.

To restore the previous behavior, users can implement a custom `main()` function using `absl.app` as command-line parser + runner, for example as the previous default `main()` function that is removed by this very commit.

-----------------

Happy to hear your thoughts, this is part of the analysis tools refactoring (#2017).

gold_comments.issue_summary: Not sure about this bit yet - 1), it still requires a `from absl import app` statement in all APIs below (it will be cached in `sys.modules` in all but the first call, but still), and 2) it could break users importing `contextlib` before `google-benchmark`, as this call marks _all_ previously loaded contextlib modules for GC.
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The diff deletes `contextlib` after use (`del contextlib`) and still conditionally imports `absl.app` in multiple functions, which the reviewer flagged as potentially breaking users who imported `contextlib` earlier.
gold_comments.rationale: Deleting `contextlib` after use can cause issues for users who imported it before loading google-benchmark, as it marks all previously loaded contextlib modules for garbage collection.
